Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

Our two most popular styles are roller blinds and Venetian blinds, so let me break them down for you.

Roller blinds are the everyday all-rounder: one piece of fabric that rolls up neatly, minimal maintenance, and loads of fabric choices from dimout to blackout to moisture-resistant. They tend to be the best value for money and suit almost any room.

Venetian blinds (usually aluminium or wooden slats) win on light control, you can tilt the slats to let in exactly as much light as you want while keeping privacy. They look a bit more premium but take slightly more cleaning, as each slat gathers dust.

Given you want everyday use, quality, and value for money, I'd lean toward roller blinds as your best match.
